narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we will delve into the fascinating world of the human brain. We'll explore its intricate structure and understand the vital functions each part performs, giving us a deeper appreciation for this incredible organ. Our learning journey today will focus on identifying the major parts of the human brain, which include the fore-brain, mid-brain, and hind-brain. We will also describe the primary functions associated with each of these crucial brain regions. Finally, we'll gain an understanding of how the brain meticulously coordinates various activities throughout our body, enabling us to think, feel, and move. Let's begin our exploration of the brain's remarkable capabilities.
